lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Good day! I'm Gus, the village <color=red>gardener</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I was writing down the story of my giant pumpkin when a gust of wind blew five <color=red>words</color> clean off the page!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Choose the word that fits each gap. Fill all five and five new books will appear in the library.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
The seed was so small that I could hardly <color=red>_____</color> it in my palm.
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about how you would notice something tiny.
lines.correctText: The seed was so small that I could hardly <color=red>see</color> it in my palm.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
It rained all week, so the soil was soft and <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What is soil like after a week of rain?
lines.correctText: It rained all week, so the soil was soft and <color=red>damp</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
Slowly, a green shoot began to <color=red>_____</color> up through the earth.
lines.hint: Not quite. Which word shows the shoot getting through the soil?
lines.correctText: Slowly, a green shoot began to <color=red>push</color> up through the earth.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
By summer, the pumpkin was <color=red>_____</color> than any I had ever grown.
lines.hint: Not quite. Look at the word 'than'. It is comparing two things.
lines.correctText: By summer, the pumpkin was <color=red>larger</color> than any I had ever grown.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
I was so proud that I <color=red>_____</color> the whole village to come and see it.
lines.hint: Not quite. The rest of the story is in the past tense.
lines.correctText: I was so proud that I <color=red>invited</color> the whole village to come and see it.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Every word back in its place! Thank you. Five new <color=red>books</color> are on their way to the library.

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thanks again for rescuing my story. The library's looking much fuller now, don't you think?
